jobs.title: Director: Strategic Partnerships and External Capacity Development
jobs.description: The Human Sciences Research Council (HSRC) is seeking an experienced, visionary Director to lead Strategic Partnerships and External Capacity Development. The successful incumbent will coordinate national and international research networks, secure strategic funding partnerships, and enhance capacity building in social science research methodologies.
requirements: Ph.D. in Social Sciences, Development Studies, Public Policy, or related academic discipline
Minimum 8 years of research leadership experience with a proven high-impact publication record
Demonstrated track record of securing international donor funding and research grants
Excellent stakeholder relations and capacity building capability in South Africa and across the African continent

jobs.title: Manager: Strategic Partnerships and Internationalisation
jobs.description: We are looking for a highly capable Manager to drive internationalisation initiatives, foster strategic bilateral research agreements, and manage relationships with global science councils and multinational development agencies.
requirements: Master's Degree in International Relations, Development Studies, or Social Sciences
At least 5 years experience in managing international partnership networks or research administration
Proficiency in project management frameworks and corporate social investment programs
Experience collaborating with international research consortiums (e.g., European Union, AU, UN)

jobs.title: Stakeholder and Partnership Officer
jobs.description: The Corporate Services department requires a Stakeholder and Partnership Officer to manage public affairs, coordinate inter-governmental relations, maintain database registers of institutional partners, and support executive outreach.
requirements: Bachelor's Degree in Communication, Public Relations, or Social Sciences
3 years of experience in public affairs, community development, or stakeholder engagement
Strong writing skills, event management experience, and digital collaboration tool expertise

jobs.title: Proofreaders
jobs.description: HSRC invites applications for temporary or contract Proofreaders to review, copyedit, and formatting academic monographs, research briefs, policy documents, and survey reports prior to publication.
requirements: Degree in English, Linguistics, Journalism, or Social Sciences
Proven experience copyediting and proofreading high-quality academic publications, APA/Chicago style sheets
Outstanding attention to detail and ability to work under strict publishing deadlines

jobs.title: HSRC Language Editors
jobs.description: We require experienced academic Language Editors to polish scientific proposals, translate complex jargon into policy-friendly language, and optimize research manuscripts for international peer-reviewed journals.
requirements: Postgraduate degree in English, Applied Linguistics, or a Social Sciences field
Minimum 5 years of editing academic manuscripts in high-impact publishing houses
Knowledge of global research standards and quantitative/qualitative formatting conventions

evaluations.comments: Elizabeth Chen presents an outstanding research proposal on single-cell computational oncology. She has demonstrated high technical ability and scientific depth in her Nature Communications paper. I strongly recommend her for the bioinformatics opening.

referees.name: Prof. David K. Gabor
referees.letterContent: I have supervised Elizabeth's doctoral studies for 4 years. She is exceptionally talented, highly collaborative, and stands in the top 5% of doctoral researchers I have advised over two decades. Her capacity for bridging computer science and computational biology is first-rate.
